seatedAndFloorAccess.name: Z-Press
seatedAndFloorAccess.note: CURATED_DEMANDS (demands.js) sets this deliberately: "Z-press: seated ON THE FLOOR". Not a bug — the combination genuinely occurs for this one movement, which is exactly why validateDemandMetadata does not treat seated+floorAccess as a hard contradiction (unlike impact+seated or high-balance+lying, which it does reject).
